palette.notes: 22 colours measured, 2 ramps with a small median hue shift (5.4 deg); saturated rainbow hair strands and a green VU meter against grey metal and a pale skin ramp.

lighting: Flat front light on the face, near-white highlight on cheek and forehead; metallic speaker parts get hard specular rims.
silhouette: Large side-profile face fills the frame; strong dark lashes and lip line carry the read, cyber headphone shapes frame the back of the head.

motion.timing: Holds median 133.3 ms (on 4s, 7.54 drawings/s). A short loop: eyes close and open, lips part, VU bars and speaker pulse; the rest stays still.

texture: Clean pixels, almost no dither (0.0012 share); flat colour blocks with hand-placed AA on the lash line.
camera: Locked frame, no camera move; the whole clip is one held portrait.

acting.enters: Present from frame one; no entrance.
acting.acts: Slow blink and small mouth move while the equaliser bars bounce, like singing to the music.
acting.depth: Single plane; face foreground, machinery behind the ear.

techniques: animate only the eyes, mouth and meter; hold everything else
animation on 4s (133 ms) for a calm, illustrated feel
saturated accent strands against neutral grey metal
feel: big still portrait + blink and lip loop on 4s + bouncing meter = hypnotic music-loop mood
for_fred: When Fred is just listening or reacting, keep his body still and move only eyes and mouth on 4s with a slow blink; it reads as alive without overusing the bounce.
